newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed ahead of auction.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates mixed ahead of auction.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mixed as banks groped for direction ahead of the treasury bills auction later in the day, traders said.
A trader said banks were divided on where the rates of longer-termed securities would go after the auction committee changed the T-bill offer volumes.
"Some said short-term rates would go down due to the high liquidity, but others said the bigger auction volume would temper any fall," he said.
The short-term PHIBOR were mostly higher following the rise in the overnight money.
